# `optionMatchToFromOption`

Suggests Effect.fromOption when Option.match or an Option tag conditional only converts Some to Effect.succeed and None to Effect.fail

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377118` |
| Language Service name | `optionMatchToFromOption` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/option-match-to-from-option` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Data, Effect, Option } from "effect"

class UserNotFound extends Data.TaggedError("UserNotFound")<{
  readonly id: string
}> {}

declare const findUser: (id: string) => Option.Option<{ readonly name: string }>

export const getUser = (id: string) =>
  Option.match(findUser(id), {
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(option-match-to-from-option): `Effect.fromOption` expresses this Option-to-Effect conversion more directly than `Option.match` or an Option tag conditional.
*/
    onNone: () => Effect.fail(new UserNotFound({ id })),
    onSome: (user) => Effect.succeed(user)
  })
```
